# Kyne Solutions (Kyne Parcel)

> Kyne Solutions, also called Kyne Parcel, is an e-commerce logistics and delivery company in Lagos, Nigeria. Founded on 2 July 2019 by Mr. Adeitan Ogunmikan. Tagline: "Your E-commerce Logistics Bro". Services: order fulfillment, warehousing and same-day delivery for online vendors across all of Lagos State and Ogun State border towns.

## Key facts
- Founded: 2 July 2019, Lagos, Nigeria
- Founder: Mr. Adeitan Ogunmikan
- Customers: e-commerce vendors (social media sellers, online stores)
- Services: order fulfillment, warehousing, same-day delivery
- Coverage: all of Lagos (Ikeja, Lekki, Victoria Island, Ikoyi, Lagos Island, Ajah, Yaba, Surulere, Mushin, Oshodi and Isolo, Egbeda and Alimosho, Festac and Amuwo-Odofin, Apapa, Ojo, Agege, Ogba and Ifako-Ijaiye, Gbagada, Maryland and Anthony, Magodo and Ketu, Ikorodu) and Ogun border towns (Sango-Ota, Ifo and Akute, Mowe and Ibafo, Arepo, Agbara)
- Strengths: consistency, wide delivery coverage, warehousing
- Booking platform: http://kyneparcel.com/
- Phone: 0915 178 2751 (+2349151782751)
- Email: kynesolutions@gmail.com
- Instagram: @kynesolutions
- TikTok: @kyne.solution
